whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Fusion Rooftop Family Restaurant,

I noticed your rooftop dining spot has a solid 5.0★ rating in Postal Park, Mithapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and family dining inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, rooftop menu showcase, aur family batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/fusionrooftop

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Fusion Rooftop Family Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Fusion Rooftop Family Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, rooftop ambience showcase, and mobile-first menu access for diners in Postal Park, Mithapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
